// Planted fixture for class `repo_layout`. Read as TEXT by
// tests/workspace_assumptions_are_enumerated.rs; never compiled.
fn planted_repo_layout(root: &Path) -> PathBuf {
    let _ = std::env::var("QONTINUI_ROOT");
    root.join("qontinui-claude-config").join(".claude/commands")
}

// The runner-local bare-sibling-name refinement (no `../`, not fleet-only).
fn planted_repo_layout_bare_sibling(workspace: &Path) -> PathBuf {
    workspace.join("qontinui-web")
}
